objective: Compare drift-preserving Top2 momentum with V4 monthly reweighting

rule.signal: first observed trading session of each calendar month at close
rule.factor: adjusted close(T)/adjusted close(T-60 trading sessions)-1; fixed Top2
rule.execution: T+1 open; equal-value targets only when Top2 membership changes; otherwise preserve share counts; shared cash ledger copied from V4; 100-share lots, capacity, price locks, fees and slippage
rule.matched_return_interpretation: same realized holdings path without fees; net-minus-matched is execution friction, not selection alpha
